title: Bybit $1.5B hack (21 Feb 2025)
description: An attacker drained ~400k ETH from Bybit's Ethereum cold wallet during a routine cold-to-warm transfer (~14:16 UTC). The largest crypto theft on record; ETH and BTC sold off through the evening.

headlines.title: Bybit ETH multisig cold wallet just made a transfer to our warm wallet about 1 hr ago. It appears that this specific transaction was musked, the hacker took control of the specific ETH cold wallet
headlines.tsNote: Post quoted by Kitco and Forklog on 21 Feb 2025. It says the transfer was 'about 1 hr ago' and the drain was at 14:16 UTC, so it is placed at 15:00 UTC (minute not verified).

headlines.title: Bybit Hit by Crypto's Worst Hack With Almost $1.5 Billion Stolen
$1.5 billion hack strikes major cryptocurrency exchange Bybit
headlines.tsNote: AP story dated 22 Feb 2025; time not verified, placed at 04:00 UTC.

sources: Prices: Binance public klines BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, 15m (data-api.binance.vision)
